short_description: Enforce deep focus and lock Max Ink reading mode on TCL NXTPAPER devices via Shizuku.
detailed_description:
Analog Anchor companion for TCL NXTPAPER devices.

Make the decision once. Give reading your attention.

Features:
- Pre-commitment durations: 5 minutes default, or 2, 4, 6, 12 hours.
- Physical switch monitoring: Automatically brings the screen back to Max Ink if switched to Normal early.
- Friction-backed Emergency Stop: Requires a 5-minute cooldown wait before exit.
- Fully offline & battery friendly.
- Powered by Shizuku without requiring root.
